review:
Zeus pushed further, with multiplier symbols up to 2,500x. Eight or more matching symbols anywhere on the 6x5 grid win and tumble, and every multiplier landing in the same spin adds together.

Four scatters give 15 free spins (three more add five), and a wheel picks the bonus mode first – including one where multipliers build a running total. 96.51% RTP. For players who know the original and want bigger multipliers.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
